observations.body: All Israel asks for lighter service, Rehoboam rejects elder counsel, and ten tribes make Jeroboam king while Judah remains with David’s house.

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 12:1–24 as one people becomes two kingdoms evidence before carrying it into another source.
